import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind


class TotalChargesCleaner(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TotalChargesCleaner",
        kind=OperatorKind.IMPUTER,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="清洗包含空白字符串的数值列并转换为浮点型，缺失值填充为指定值",
        conditions=["string_typed_numeric", "has_missing_values"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={"column": "total_charges", "fill_value": 0.0},
        parent="TotalChargesCleaner@1",
    )

    def __init__(self, column: str = "total_charges", fill_value: float = 0.0):
        self.column = column
        self.fill_value = fill_value

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y=None):
        self.feature_names_in_ = list(X.columns)
        self.column_present_ = self.column in X.columns
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        X = X.copy()
        if self.column in X.columns:
            cleaned = pd.to_numeric(
                X[self.column].astype(str).str.strip(),
                errors="coerce"
            ).fillna(self.fill_value)
            X[self.column] = cleaned.astype(float)
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality


class TenureBucketizer(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TenureBucketizer",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="将在网时长tenure字段按业务经验分箱为离散区间段，增强模型表现与可解释性",
        conditions=["time_tenure", "numeric_features"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={
            "input_col": "tenure",
            "output_col": "tenure_bucket",
            "bins": (-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, float("inf")),
            "labels": ("0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"),
            "fill_missing": "Unknown",
        },
        parent="TenureBucketizer@1",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        input_col="tenure",
        output_col="tenure_bucket",
        bins=(-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, float("inf")),
        labels=("0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"),
        fill_missing="Unknown",
    ):
        self.input_col = input_col
        self.output_col = output_col
        self.bins = bins
        self.labels = labels
        self.fill_missing = fill_missing

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        self.bins_ = list(self.bins) if self.bins is not None else [-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, float("inf")]
        self.labels_ = list(self.labels) if self.labels is not None else ["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"]
        self.is_fitted_ = True
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        out_col = self.output_col if self.output_col else f"{self.input_col}_bucket"

        try:
            bins = self.bins_
        except AttributeError:
            bins = list(self.bins) if self.bins is not None else [-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, float("inf")]

        try:
            labels = self.labels_
        except AttributeError:
            labels = list(self.labels) if self.labels is not None else ["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"]

        if self.input_col not in X.columns:
            X[out_col] = str(self.fill_missing)
            return X

        s = pd.to_numeric(X[self.input_col], errors="coerce")
        cut_res = pd.cut(s, bins=bins, labels=labels)
        
        bucket_s = cut_res.astype(str)
        bucket_s = bucket_s.replace({"nan": str(self.fill_missing), "NaN": str(self.fill_missing), "<NA>": str(self.fill_missing)})
        
        X[out_col] = bucket_s
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.base import ClassifierMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class BalancedLightGBMClassifier(ClassifierMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="BalancedLightGBMClassifier",
        kind=OperatorKind.MODEL,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="使用LightGBM训练分类模型，自动平衡正负样本权重以应对不平衡数据",
        conditions=["imbalanced", "numeric_features", "has_categorical_features"],
        dependencies=["lightgbm", "scikit-learn", "pandas", "numpy"],
        params={
            "n_estimators": 400,
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "class_weight": "balanced",
            "random_state": 42,
            "verbose": -1
        },
        parent="BalancedLightGBMClassifier@1"
    )

    def __init__(
        self, 
        n_estimators=400, 
        learning_rate=0.05, 
        num_leaves=31, 
        class_weight="balanced", 
        random_state=42, 
        verbose=-1
    ):
        self.n_estimators = n_estimators
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate
        self.num_leaves = num_leaves
        self.class_weight = class_weight
        self.random_state = random_state
        self.verbose = verbose

    def fit(self, X, y):
        # 识别类别型特征
        self.categorical_cols_ = X.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category', 'string']).columns.tolist()
        self.categories_ = {}
        
        X_fit = X.copy()
        for col in self.categorical_cols_:
            X_fit[col] = X_fit[col].astype('category')
            self.categories_[col] = X_fit[col].cat.categories

        self.model_ = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
            n_estimators=self.n_estimators,
            learning_rate=self.learning_rate,
            num_leaves=self.num_leaves,
            class_weight=self.class_weight,
            random_state=self.random_state,
            verbose=self.verbose
        )
        
        self.model_.fit(X_fit, y)
        self.classes_ = self.model_.classes_
        return self

    def _preprocess(self, X):
        X_pred = X.copy()
        for col in self.categorical_cols_:
            if col in X_pred.columns:
                # 使用训练集中的类别对齐，未见类别和缺失值会自动转化为 NaN，LightGBM 可原生处理
                X_pred[col] = pd.Categorical(X_pred[col], categories=self.categories_[col])
        return X_pred

    def predict(self, X):
        X_pred = self._preprocess(X)
        return self.model_.predict(X_pred)

    def predict_proba(self, X):
        X_pred = self._preprocess(X)
        return self.model_.predict_proba(X_pred)

    def transform(self, X):
        X_copy = X.copy()
        preds = self.predict(X_copy)
        return pd.DataFrame({"prediction": preds}, index=X_copy.index)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin

from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality


class ServiceCountFeature(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ServiceCountFeature",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="统计客户订购的增值服务总数，反映客户业务粘性",
        conditions=["has_categorical_features"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={
            "service_cols": ("online_security", "tech_support", "streaming_tv"),
            "positive_values": ("Yes", "是", "1"),
            "output_col": "n_services",
        },
        parent="ServiceCountFeature@1",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        service_cols=("online_security", "tech_support", "streaming_tv"),
        positive_values=("Yes", "是", "1"),
        output_col="n_services",
    ):
        self.service_cols = service_cols
        self.positive_values = positive_values
        self.output_col = output_col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        cols = list(self.service_cols) if self.service_cols is not None else []
        self.available_cols_ = [c for c in cols if c in X.columns]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        if not isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame):
            raise TypeError("Input X must be a pandas DataFrame.")

        pos_set = set(self.positive_values) if self.positive_values is not None else {"Yes", "是", "1"}
        pos_str_set = {str(v).strip().lower() for v in pos_set}

        count_series = pd.Series(0, index=X.index, dtype=np.int64)

        for col in self.available_cols_:
            if col in X.columns:
                series = X[col]
                is_pos = series.isin(pos_set) | series.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().isin(pos_str_set)
                count_series = count_series + is_pos.fillna(False).astype(np.int64)

        X[self.output_col] = count_series
        return X

lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 随机森林防过拟合与召回优化
lessons.trigger: 使用随机森林模型，面临过拟合风险，或业务要求召回优先时
lessons.fix: 设置 n_estimators 300 左右，限制 max_depth 在 8~16 防止过拟合；召回优先时需配合调整分类阈值。

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败

lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: 避免在沙箱中使用 getattr 等受限反射函数，访问可选属性应使用 try/except AttributeError
lessons.trigger: 静态安全检查拦截（E_UNSAFE），提示“禁止调用 getattr()”或其它沙箱禁用的内置函数
lessons.fix: 避免使用 getattr、setattr 等受限反射函数；获取可能未初始化的属性时，改用直接属性访问并配合 try/except AttributeError 来提供默认值

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低

lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率
